name: expert-endorsements
title: Expert endorsements
description: Quotes from doctors, chefs and coaches with their qualification as real text, a required disclosure and a Sponsored badge for paid voices.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, experts ({ id, name, credential, quote, affiliation?, photo?, href?, sponsored? }) and disclosure. The disclosure is required and printed under the grid, because endorsements are regulated in many markets: say whether the experts were paid, or which of them were; pass null only when you have checked that nothing needs saying. An expert with sponsored: true carries a solid Sponsored badge on the top edge of the card and a rel="sponsored" link. The credential is a chip of real text that a screen reader hears as 'Credential: Dermatologist, MD', never part of the picture, and the portrait shows at once (initials, without a title such as Dr., stand in until it loads). Two to six experts; three sit in a row on a desktop, four sit two by two, and an odd last card spans the width on a tablet. labels carries the fixed words.
